title: superclaude is Python: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py launches Claude Code with no bash in the launch path
intention: superclaude is Python: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py launches Claude Code on every box with the same standing contract the bash launcher has, asking the launch tool every OS question, so no bash is in the launch path.
why: Measured 2026-11-22 on akiendell: `cairn superclaude` exited 127 silently because where.exe lists WSL's C:/Windows/System32/bash.exe before Git Bash, which is not on PATH; under Git Bash Windows 11's sudo.exe refused every password. The launcher is 882 lines of bash, so Windows needs a bash it does not have. Outline 10.3.2.1: superclaude is Python on every box.
traces_to: Outline 10.3.2.1 and 5.4.3.8 (superclaude is Python; Windows needs no bash); RULE 1 (OS answers come from the system device's published tool; recovery is reached through its CLI); Law 1 (the settled launcher is ported, not re-derived); Law 3 (the proof measures the launch plan, not a claim).
how: New cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py porting the 882-line bash cairn/devices/cc/superclaude: flag parse and the context switch (command line > environment > file default), instance and held-instance move, session name and CAIRN_USER, preflight by calling recovery's floor.py as a subprocess CLI (RULE 1: cc may not import recovery) with the residue riding --append-system-prompt, memory_link.py, the CAIRN_FLOOR_FINDINGS carry-in, claude install when absent, the flags home and the restart loop (inner mode), the ground loop and web server via launch.service_spawn, port 80 via launch.port_listening, the trace wire, --dry-run, tmux mode, and the memory scope via launch.scoped_exec. It never elevates and never asks for a password: elevation is the shell's, settled before Python starts (outline 5.4.3.8.6, 10.3.2.1); it sets IS_SANDBOX=1 so Claude Code accepts bypass permissions under root, and carries the elevation fact to Claude as one report line. claude runs in THIS console with inherited stdio, as UnseenUniversity bin/superclaude.ps1 does. Every OS question goes through cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/launch/launch.py; the module has no os.name, sys.platform, platform.system test. The bash stays until bin/cairn.py dispatches to the .py (child 5).

clauses.claim: --dry-run prints the resolved context state and claude command with the bash's semantics: --1m wins over a 200K environment, --200k imposes, then the environment, then the file default 200K, the last launching 1M only when FILE_DEFAULT_200K is 0
an instance whose loop.pid names a live process moves to the next free one: a number counts up, a word takes _N, and the move is reported

the preflight runs floor.py verify, then apply on a miss, then report; its text rides --append-system-prompt and is empty when the floor is up; --no-preflight skips it and the trace wire counts the bypass
the ground loop and the web server start through launch.service_spawn, neither under --dry-run, and the web server not when port 80 listens or CAIRN_HOME_HOST names another box

the restart loop relaunches claude with --continue on COMMAND_RESTART.flag and clean on COMMAND_RESTART_FRESH.flag, consuming the flag by moving it; COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART.flag wins and is not consumed; loop.pid names the loop
claude is spawned in this console with inherited stdio: no capture, no creation flags, and the exit code is claude's
the module text has none of os.name, sys.platform, platform.system, the word bash, a sudo password flag, or a password prompt; it never elevates and sets IS_SANDBOX=1 in claude's environment

claude is started through launch.scoped_exec's argv under MemoryHigh 6G, MemoryMax 8G and MemorySwapMax 1G where the box has a scope, and the plan names which way it went (scope, plain, not-on-this-box)

decisions.text: D1: flag parse, the context switch, session identity, held-instance move and --dry-run, ported from the bash :97-141 :207-289 :779-798 as a pure plan function the proof can call.

D2: the preflight through floor.py's CLI, memory_link, the carried-in CAIRN_FLOOR_FINDINGS, the elevation fact as a report line (never a prompt), IS_SANDBOX=1, claude install, the trace wire; seams are function parameters.

D3: the services (ground loop, web server) via launch.service_spawn and port_listening; tmux and the memory-capped scope via launch.scoped_argv/scoped_exec (6G/8G/1G); the inner restart loop with inherited stdio.
D4: the proof, one tooth per clause, red first; and the charter invoke line naming superclaude.py.
